issues.title: Revenue Volatility from Climate Risk
issues.hover_description: Physical climate events and transition risks disrupting revenue streams across BUs.
issues.nature_of_impact: Revenue disruption from extreme weather and regulatory changes

issues.title: Supply Chain Disruption
issues.hover_description: Critical dependencies on single-source suppliers in high-risk geographies.
issues.nature_of_impact: Production halts, cost overruns, delivery failures

issues.title: Stranded Asset Exposure
issues.hover_description: Assets at risk of write-down due to energy transition or regulatory obsolescence.

issues.title: ESG Regulatory Fines & Penalties
issues.hover_description: Non-compliance with CSRD, EU Taxonomy, SEC climate disclosure rules.
issues.nature_of_impact: Financial penalties, reputational damage, operational restrictions

issues.title: Rising Insurance Premiums
issues.hover_description: Climate-linked insurance cost escalation across facilities and supply chains.
issues.nature_of_impact: Increased operational costs, potential coverage gaps

issues.title: Green Premium & Cost of Capital
issues.hover_description: Higher borrowing costs for companies with poor ESG ratings.
issues.nature_of_impact: Increased cost of debt, reduced investment capacity

issues.title: Scope 1-3 Carbon Emissions
issues.hover_description: Direct, energy, and value-chain greenhouse gas emissions across all BUs.
issues.nature_of_impact: Climate change acceleration, carbon tax liability

issues.title: Water Scarcity & Stress
issues.hover_description: Manufacturing facilities in water-stressed regions facing curtailment risk.
issues.nature_of_impact: Production shutdowns, community conflict, regulatory restrictions

issues.title: Biodiversity & Ecosystem Degradation
issues.hover_description: Raw material extraction causing habitat destruction and species loss.
issues.nature_of_impact: Supply chain vulnerability, social license risk

issues.title: Hazardous Waste & Pollution
issues.hover_description: Toxic chemical discharge and e-waste from manufacturing processes.
issues.nature_of_impact: Soil/water contamination, health impacts, legal liability

issues.title: Circular Economy Readiness
issues.hover_description: Product design and packaging not aligned with EU circular economy mandates.
issues.nature_of_impact: Compliance costs, competitive disadvantage, waste penalties

issues.title: Deforestation in Supply Chains
issues.hover_description: Commodity sourcing linked to tropical deforestation (palm oil, soy, timber).
issues.nature_of_impact: Reputational damage, EU Deforestation Regulation penalties

issues.title: Labor Rights & Working Conditions
issues.hover_description: Forced labor, excessive hours, and unsafe conditions in tier-2/3 suppliers.

issues.title: Data Privacy & Cybersecurity
issues.hover_description: Customer and patient data at risk from cyber attacks and weak governance.
issues.nature_of_impact: Identity theft, regulatory fines (GDPR), loss of trust

issues.title: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
issues.hover_description: Underrepresentation in leadership and pay gap disparities.
issues.nature_of_impact: Talent attrition, innovation gap, shareholder activism

issues.title: AI Ethics & Algorithmic Bias
issues.hover_description: AI-powered hiring, pricing, and diagnostic tools exhibiting systemic bias.
issues.stakeholders_subgroup: Digital Rights Activists; EU AI Act Authority
issues.nature_of_impact: Discrimination lawsuits, regulatory penalties, trust erosion

issues.title: Community Displacement & Land Rights
issues.hover_description: Facility expansion displacing indigenous or marginalized communities.
issues.nature_of_impact: Social license revocation, project delays, legal action

issues.title: Product Safety & Consumer Health
issues.hover_description: Pharmaceutical side-effects and consumer product contamination risks.
issues.nature_of_impact: Recalls, lawsuits, loss of market authorization

issues.title: Just Transition & Workforce Reskilling
issues.hover_description: Automation and green transition leaving workers behind without retraining.
issues.nature_of_impact: Strikes, political backlash, talent pipeline disruption

interdependencies.description: Carbon tax and ETS obligations directly reduce profit margins and cause revenue volatility.
Water-stressed manufacturing sites face production shutdowns, cascading through supply chains.
Labor violations in suppliers trigger audits, sanctions, and sourcing disruptions.
High-carbon assets become economically unviable as carbon pricing tightens.
Ecosystem degradation intensifies pressure on remaining forested supply zones.
Poor data governance feeds biased training data into AI systems.
Biased AI hiring tools perpetuate underrepresentation and pay gaps.
Poorly managed workforce transition increases labor unrest and rights violations.
Regulatory penalties worsen ESG ratings, increasing cost of capital.
Pollution from facilities makes surrounding areas uninhabitable, displacing communities.
Product safety failures trigger massive regulatory penalties and market bans.
Linear production models generate excess waste and associated Scope 3 emissions.
